rationale: The short thesis is playing out mechanically — price broke the $40.13 day low on the heaviest 1m volume since entry (31.5k shares), made new session lows at $39.92, and the only bounce attempt since came on weak volume (~9k) while staying well below session VWAP ($42.12). With negative tape (SPY -0.72%, VIXY up), no new headlines, and the unfilled gap at $38.89 still offering follow-through toward the $39.40 target, there is no reversal signal that would justify closing the winner, and no evidence remotely strong enough to pay the cost of flipping long at session lows.
